phrases.speak: What if eleven free Claude skills could help you test a business idea before you spend money launching it?
phrases.show: What if eleven free Claude skills could help you test a business idea before you spend money launching it?

phrases.speak: Meet Founder Skill, an open-source toolkit with eleven specialized skills for planning and testing a business. It is free and M I T licensed.
phrases.show: Founder Skill: eleven specialized skills. Free, MIT, no signup.

phrases.speak: Start with a virtual board of directors that challenges your idea from three different business perspectives. Each member scores it, and votes.
phrases.show: A virtual board challenges your idea from three perspectives.

phrases.speak: Research competitors, then simulate how one hundred different buyer scenarios might respond to your offer. These buyers are simulated, not real customers.
Test your pricing and calculate costs, margins, break-even points, and potential profit. In the example, each cup leaves four dollars seventy six, and break-even is one hundred eighty six cups a day.
The remaining skills help shape your offer, marketing, brand, operations, launch strategy, and final business plan.
phrases.show: Offer, marketing, brand, operations, launch, business plan.

phrases.speak: To install them, open the Founder Skill GitHub repository, add its plugin marketplace in Claude Code, then install the Founder Skill plugin. The commands then appear with the founder skill prefix.
phrases.show: Add the marketplace in Claude Code. Install the plugin.

phrases.speak: Now you can pressure-test your idea before launch. Just remember: simulated buyers and financial projections aren't proof of real market demand.
phrases.show: Simulated buyers and projections aren't proof of demand.

phrases.speak: Save this tutorial and follow Agentoon dot A I for more Claude Code skills!
